$description: The cross-family overlay contract (#3142, #3298): the dialog surface is a non-scrolling column, DialogBody is the one scroll owner and headers/footers are fixed opaque full-width bands, and centered Web overlays resolve their width from a semantic token rather than a consumer literal. The anchored/menu member's row band remains pattern.popup-menu; this block names the shared operation-surface constraints, not a second list contract.
